fragment.response_text: {"paragraphs":[{"paragraph_id":"MA-S3:P1__f8","paragraph_markdown":"Within the dedicated attention branch, the model processes each query's passage set by extracting the per-query similarity vector from the batch-level similarity matrix and the corresponding relevance label vector.
